evidence.reason: Recorded the command's own exit code at the `exit` event (only while `killedByUs` is still false) and settled it in preference to a late `close`, so a timeout or abort that lands while a backgrounded descendant holds the pipes can no longer relabel a finished command as `killed`; added a regression test in test/harness/run.test.ts (local tests not run — only git commands are permitted in this harness, CI is the authority).
